            <div class="postBody">

        MAF（Microsoft Agent Framwork）已经出来有一段时间，最近看到它的commit比较频繁，估计是为了在.NET Conf 2025发布1.0.0的正式版。预览版也并不妨碍我们的学习，那么从今天开始，我们就通过微软官方学习文档来一起进入MAF的世界吧。
    </div>
<div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p><span><span>大家好，我是Edison。</span></span></p>
<p><span><span>MAF（Microsoft Agent Framwork）已经出来有一段时间，最近看到它的commit比较频繁，估计是为了在.NET Conf 2025发布1.0.0的正式版<span>。预览版也并不妨碍我们的学习，那么从今天开始，我们就通过微软官方学习文档来一起进入MAF的世界吧。</span></span></span></p>
<h1><strong>MAF简单介绍</strong></h1>
<p><span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span>Microsoft Agent Framework (MAF)<span><span>&nbsp;是微软最新推出的<span>统一的智能体开发框架<span>，用于生成适用于 .NET 和 Python 的 AI Agent（智能体）和 Multi Agent Workflow（多智能体工作流）。&nbsp;</span></span></span></span></span></span><span>MAF 汇集了 Semantic Kernel 和 AutoGen 两个知名项目的优点，并扩展了其优势，同时添加了新功能。换句话说，它们由同一开发团队构建，是今后构建AI Agent的统一基础。</span></p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/381412/202511/381412-20251117183509476-964824763.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span><span>简而言之，MAF是微软推出的智能体开发的“<span>终极武器<span>”！</span></span></span></span></p>
<p data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span><span>对于.NET技术栈的开发团队而言，其意义十分重大，它将已有的技术版图组合起来，形成一个AI时代的完整技术栈：</span></span></p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/381412/202511/381412-20251117183524834-81218211.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span><span>对于Edison所在的团队来说，.NET技术栈开发者可以使用MAF快速进入Agent开发领域，转型速度飞快。同时，在机器学习、模型训练 和 推理服务器（Inference Server）方面，我们也在使用Python来做，将各自的优势保留并发挥即可。</span></span></p>
<h1><span>AI Agent是什么？</span></h1>
<p><span><span>让我们再来看看AI Agent（又称为AI智能体）是什么，它其实是一个使用LLM来处理用户输入、做出决策、调用工具（MCP服务器）来执行并生成响应以完成某个具体的任务。</span></span></p>
<p><span><span>下图说明了AI Agent中的核心组件及其交互：</span></span></p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/381412/202511/381412-20251117183557086-1963585083.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p><span><span>AI Agent适用于需要自主决策、规划试验 和 基于聊天 的用户交互应用程序，特别是对于输入任务非结构化且无法提前定义的情况，它们特别有用。这一类场景常见于客户支持、教育辅导、研究帮助等领域。</span></span></p>
<p><span><span>需要注意的是：<span><strong>AI Agent不适合高度结构化且要求严格遵循预定义规则的任务</strong><span>。也就是说，<span data-pm-slice="0 0 []">如果应用程序预期有特定类型的输入，并且具有明确定义的作业顺序，则使用 AI Agent可能会带来不必要的不确定性、延迟和成本。</span></span></span></span></span></p>
<h1><span>Workflow是什么？</span></h1>
<p><span><span>Workflow即工作流，它可以表达预定义的作业序列，<span>工作流旨在处理可能涉及多个AI Agent、人工交互 和 与外部系统的集成的复杂且长时间运行的进程<span>。</span></span></span></span></p>
<p><span><span>很多时候，我们可以显示定义工作流的执行序列，从而更好地控制执行路径。</span></span></p>
<p><span><span>下图演示了链接两个AI Agent 和 一个函数方法 的工作流示例：</span></span></p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/381412/202511/381412-20251117183620750-714369338.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p><span><span>工作流提供了一种结构化方法，用于管理涉及多个步骤、决策点 和 与各种系统或Agent交互的复杂流程。</span></span></p>
<h1><span>快速开始创建Agent</span></h1>
<p><span><span>这里我们创建一个.NET控制台项目，安装以下组件包：</span></span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_Highlighter">
<pre class="brush:csharp;gutter:true;">&lt;PackageReference Include="Azure.AI.OpenAI" Version="2.5.0-beta.1" /&gt;
&lt;PackageReference Include="Microsoft.Agents.AI.OpenAI" Version="1.0.0-preview.251110.1" /&gt;</pre>
</div>
<p><span><span>假定我们有如下配置文件定义了我们可以用到的LLM API：</span></span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_Highlighter">
<pre class="brush:csharp;gutter:true;">{
  "OpenAI": {
    "EndPoint": "https://api.siliconflow.cn",
    "ApiKey": "******************************",
    "ModelId": "Qwen/Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct"
  }
}
</pre>
</div>
<p>这里我们使用SiliconCloud提供的&nbsp;<span class="code-snippet__string">Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct&nbsp;模型，你可以通过这个URL注册账号：<a href="https://cloud.siliconflow.cn/i/DomqCefW" rel="noopener nofollow" target="_blank">https://cloud.siliconflow.cn/i/DomqCefW</a>&nbsp;获取免费的Token来进行本次实验。</span></p>
<p><span><span>首先，我们加载配置文件到应用程序中：</span></span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> Load configuration</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> config = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ConfigurationBuilder()
    .AddJsonFile($</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">appsettings.json</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, optional: <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">false</span>, reloadOnChange: <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">true</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    .Build();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> openAIProvider = config.GetSection(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">OpenAI</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>).Get&lt;OpenAIProvider&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">();</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)"><br></span></pre>
</div>
<p>其中，OpenAIProvider的类定义如下：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">sealed</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> OpenAIProvider
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> ApiKey { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span>; init; } = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">.Empty;
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> ModelId { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span>; init; } = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">.Empty;
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> Endpoint { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span>; init; } = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">.Empty;
}</span></pre>
</div>
<h3><span><span>Create Agent</span></span></h3>
<p><span><span>其次，我们创建第一个Hello World的Agent：</span></span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> jokerAgent = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> OpenAIClient(
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ApiKeyCredential(openAIProvider.ApiKey),
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> OpenAIClientOptions { Endpoint = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Uri(openAIProvider.Endpoint) })
    .GetChatClient(openAIProvider.ModelId)
    .CreateAIAgent(instructions: </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">You are good at telling jokes.</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, name: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Joker</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>);</pre>
</div>
<p><span><span>然后，通过简单的一句RunAsync 或 RunStreamingAsync 即可完成一次交互：</span></span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> Method 1: RunAsync</span>
Console.WriteLine(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">await</span> jokerAgent.RunAsync(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Tell me a joke about a pirate.</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">));
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> Method 2: RunStreamingAsync</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">await</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">foreach</span> (<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> update <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span> jokerAgent.RunStreamingAsync(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Tell me a joke about a car.</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">))
{
    Console.Write(update);
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p><span><span>最终的结果如下图所示，还挺幽默的：</span></span></p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/381412/202511/381412-20251117183935026-1292101870.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p><span><span>那么，如果是用的AzureOpenAI呢？只需要换成下面即可：</span></span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> jokerAgent = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> AzureOpenAIClient(
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Uri(azureOpenAIProvider.Endpoint),
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ApiKeyCredential(azureOpenAIProvider.ApiKey))
    .GetChatClient(azureOpenAIProvider.ModelId)
    .CreateAIAgent(instructions: </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">You are good at telling jokes.</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, name: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Joker</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
Console.WriteLine(</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">await</span> jokerAgent.RunAsync(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Tell me a joke about a pirate.</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>));</pre>
</div>
<h3><span data-pm-slice="1 1 [&quot;para&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;section&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{&quot;style&quot;:&quot;letter-spacing: 0.578px;text-align: left;margin: 8px;&quot;},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;},&quot;para&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;section&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{&quot;style&quot;:&quot;line-height: 1.75em;&quot;},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;},&quot;para&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;section&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{&quot;style&quot;:&quot;line-height: 1.75em;&quot;,&quot;data-pm-slice&quot;:&quot;3 3 [\&quot;para\&quot;,{\&quot;tagName\&quot;:\&quot;section\&quot;,\&quot;attributes\&quot;:{\&quot;style\&quot;:\&quot;letter-spacing: 0.578px;text-align: left;margin: 8px;\&quot;},\&quot;namespaceURI\&quot;:\&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml\&quot;}]&quot;},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;},&quot;para&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;p&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;}]"><span>多轮对话</span></span></h3>
<p><span><span>我们还可以通过AgentThread这个特性来实现具有“<span>短期记忆<span>”的<span>多轮对话<span>：</span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> thread1 =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> jokerAgent.GetNewThread();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> thread2 =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> jokerAgent.GetNewThread();
Console.WriteLine(</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">await</span> jokerAgent.RunAsync(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Tell me a joke about a pirate.</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, thread1) +<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Environment.NewLine);
Console.WriteLine(</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">await</span> jokerAgent.RunAsync(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Now add some emojis to the joke and tell it in the voice of a pirate's parrot.</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, thread1) +<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Environment.NewLine);
Console.WriteLine(</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">await</span> jokerAgent.RunAsync(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Tell me a joke about a robot.</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, thread2) +<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Environment.NewLine);
Console.WriteLine(</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">await</span> jokerAgent.RunAsync(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Now add some emojis to the joke and tell it in the voice of a robot.</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, thread2) + Environment.NewLine);</pre>
</div>
<h3><span data-pm-slice="1 1 [&quot;para&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;section&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{&quot;style&quot;:&quot;letter-spacing: 0.578px;text-align: left;margin: 8px;&quot;},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;},&quot;para&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;section&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{&quot;style&quot;:&quot;line-height: 1.75em;&quot;},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;},&quot;para&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;section&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{&quot;style&quot;:&quot;line-height: 1.75em;&quot;,&quot;data-pm-slice&quot;:&quot;3 3 [\&quot;para\&quot;,{\&quot;tagName\&quot;:\&quot;section\&quot;,\&quot;attributes\&quot;:{\&quot;style\&quot;:\&quot;letter-spacing: 0.578px;text-align: left;margin: 8px;\&quot;},\&quot;namespaceURI\&quot;:\&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml\&quot;}]&quot;},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;},&quot;para&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;p&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;}]"><span>函数调用</span></span></h3>
<p><span><span>此外，在MAF中进行<span>函数方法调用<span>也是十分的轻松：</span></span></span></span></p>
<p><span><span>定义一个简单的函数方法：</span></span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> WeatherServicePlugin
{
    [Description(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Get current weather for a location</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)]
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">async</span> Task&lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span>&gt; GetCurrentWeatherAsync(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> location)
    {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> $<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">The weather in {location} is cloudy with a high of 15°C.</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
    }
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p>然后在创建Agent时将工具列表告诉Agent即可：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> agent = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> OpenAIClient(
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ApiKeyCredential(openAIProvider.ApiKey),
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> OpenAIClientOptions { Endpoint = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Uri(openAIProvider.Endpoint) })
    .GetChatClient(openAIProvider.ModelId)
    .CreateAIAgent(
    instructions: </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">You are a helpful assistant</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, 
    tools: [AIFunctionFactory.Create(WeatherServicePlugin.GetCurrentWeatherAsync)]);
Console.WriteLine(</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">await</span> agent.RunAsync(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Tell me the weather like in Chengdu?</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>));</pre>
</div>
<p>最终显示的结果如下：</p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/381412/202511/381412-20251117184051966-1120797726.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p><span><span>而在实际开发中，基于MAF和原有的ASP.NET Core框架，将依赖注入和生命周期管理纳入进来，可以实现更为强大的模块化力量。</span></span></p>
<h3><span data-pm-slice="1 1 [&quot;para&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;section&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{&quot;style&quot;:&quot;letter-spacing: 0.578px;text-align: left;margin: 8px;&quot;},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;},&quot;para&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;section&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{&quot;style&quot;:&quot;line-height: 1.75em;&quot;},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;},&quot;para&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;section&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{&quot;style&quot;:&quot;line-height: 1.75em;&quot;,&quot;data-pm-slice&quot;:&quot;3 3 [\&quot;para\&quot;,{\&quot;tagName\&quot;:\&quot;section\&quot;,\&quot;attributes\&quot;:{\&quot;style\&quot;:\&quot;letter-spacing: 0.578px;text-align: left;margin: 8px;\&quot;},\&quot;namespaceURI\&quot;:\&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml\&quot;}]&quot;},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;},&quot;para&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;p&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;}]"><span>人工审批的函数调用</span></span></h3>
<p><span><span>相信我们在使用GitHub Copilot之类的编码智能体时会遇到，当它想要执行某个命令行或工具调用时会先征求你的审批，同意后它才会执行。其实，在Agent开发中，人工审批的工具调用也是一个常见的需求，而在MAF中，它也支持我们快速实现这个需求。</span></span></p>
<p><span><span>下面这个示例演示了如何实现人工审批的工具调用：</span></span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> weatherTool =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> AIFunctionFactory.Create(WeatherServicePlugin.GetCurrentWeatherAsync);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> approvalRequiredWeatherTool = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ApprovalRequiredAIFunction(weatherTool);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> agent = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> OpenAIClient(
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ApiKeyCredential(openAIProvider.ApiKey),
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> OpenAIClientOptions { Endpoint = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Uri(openAIProvider.Endpoint) })
    .GetChatClient(openAIProvider.ModelId)
    .CreateAIAgent(instructions: </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">You are a helpful assistant</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, tools: [approvalRequiredWeatherTool]);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> thread =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> agent.GetNewThread();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> response = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">await</span> agent.RunAsync(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Tell me the weather like in Chengdu?</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, thread);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> userInputRequests =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> response.UserInputRequests.ToList();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">while</span>(userInputRequests.Count &gt; <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> Ask the user to approve each function call request.</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> userInputResponses =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> userInputRequests
        .OfType</span>&lt;FunctionApprovalRequestContent&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">()
        .Select(functionApprovalRequest </span>=&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
        {
            Console.WriteLine($</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">The agent would like to invoke the following function, please reply Y to approve: Name {functionApprovalRequest.FunctionCall.Name}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> ChatMessage(ChatRole.User, [functionApprovalRequest.CreateResponse(Console.ReadLine()?.Equals(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Y</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ?? <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">false</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)]);
        })
        .ToList();
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> Pass the user input responses back to the agent for further processing.</span>
    response = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">await</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> agent.RunAsync(userInputResponses, thread);
    userInputRequests </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> response.UserInputRequests.ToList();
}
Console.WriteLine(Environment.NewLine </span>+ $<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Agent: {response}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>);</pre>
</div>
<p><span><span>执行结果如下图所示：只有当我们人工输入Y确认后，它才会调用工具执行。</span></span></p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/381412/202511/381412-20251117184139019-572579299.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<h1><span>小结</span></h1>
<p>本文介绍了MAF的基本功能，AI Agent和Workflow的基本概念，以及通过一个.NET控制台项目快速创建了一个Agent的代码示例。</p>
<p>下一篇，我们将继续MAF的学习。</p>
